name: Essence Powder
desc: A medicinal powder made to treat illnesses that regular medicine can't treat. It can cause more harm than good when taken by people who aren't sick, so the directions have to be followed closely.

eff.name: Increase Resonance Area - Square
eff.desc1: When used as an ingredient for a square Alchemy Core, increases the resonance area by [Lv. x 1].

eff.name: Increase Resonance Area - 1st Stratum
eff.desc1: When used as an ingredient for a slot on the line closest to the Alchemy Core, increases the resonance area by [Lv. x 1].
